configs.base_elm.yaml:
seq_len: 2048
global_batch_seqs: 256
micro_batch_seqs: 16
train_tokens: 1_000_000_000
optimizer: adamw
betas: [0.9, 0.95]
eps: 1.0e-8
weight_decay: 0.01
lr_peak: 3.0e-4
lr_min: 3.0e-5
warmup_steps: 50
schedule: cosine
grad_clip: 1.0
precision: tf32
attn_implementation: sdpa
compile: false
data_seed: 1234
eval_every_steps: 200
eval_windows: 64
eval_window_len: 1024
resume_ckpt_every_steps: 200
snapshot_fractions: [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0]
ckpt_root: /workspace/btm/ckpt
log_root: /workspace/btm/logs
configs.data.yaml:
tokenizer: EleutherAI/pythia-160m-deduped
tokenizer_revision: step143000
out_dir: /workspace/btm/data/tok
smoke_out_dir: /workspace/btm/data_smoke/tok
shard_tokens: 100_000_000
num_workers: 14
batch_docs: 256
progress_every_s: 60

filters:
  code:
    max_line_length: 1000
    avg_line_length: 100
    alphanum_fraction: 0.25
    max_size_bytes: 1_048_576
  law:
    min_chars: 500

smoke_targets:
  train: 5_000_000
  dev: 500_000
  test: 500_000

domains:
  python:
    loader: hf_stream
    source: bigcode/the-stack-dedup
    data_dir: data/python
    text_field: content
    group_field: max_stars_repo_name
    expected_fields: [content, max_stars_repo_name, avg_line_length, max_line_length, alphanum_fraction, size]
    filter: code
    targets: {train: 1_000_000_000, distill: 300_000_000, dev: 5_000_000, test: 5_000_000}

  javascript:
    loader: hf_stream
    source: bigcode/the-stack-dedup
    data_dir: data/javascript
    text_field: content
    group_field: max_stars_repo_name
    expected_fields: [content, max_stars_repo_name, avg_line_length, max_line_length, alphanum_fraction, size]
    filter: code
    targets: {train: 1_000_000_000, distill: 300_000_000, dev: 5_000_000, test: 5_000_000}

  law:
    loader: hf_stream
    source: TeraflopAI/Caselaw-Access-Project
    text_field: text
    group_field: id
    expected_fields: [id, text]
    filter: law
    targets: {train: 1_000_000_000, distill: 300_000_000, dev: 5_000_000, test: 5_000_000}

  typescript:
    loader: hf_stream
    source: bigcode/the-stack-dedup
    data_dir: data/typescript
    text_field: content
    group_field: max_stars_repo_name
    expected_fields: [content, max_stars_repo_name, avg_line_length, max_line_length, alphanum_fraction, size]
    filter: code
    targets: {dev: 1_000_000, test: 3_000_000}

  rust:
    loader: hf_stream
    source: bigcode/the-stack-dedup
    data_dir: data/rust
    text_field: content
    group_field: max_stars_repo_name
    expected_fields: [content, max_stars_repo_name, avg_line_length, max_line_length, alphanum_fraction, size]
    filter: code
    targets: {dev: 1_000_000, test: 3_000_000}

  contracts:
    loader: local_files
    source: CUAD v1 official release (Zenodo zip)
    root: /workspace/btm/raw/cuad/full_contract_txt
    glob: "**/*.txt"
    text_field: text
    group_field: path
    expected_fields: [text, path]
    filter: law
    targets: {dev: null, test: null}
    weights: {dev: 0.09, test: 0.91}

  web:
    loader: hf_stream
    source: HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu
    config: sample-10BT
    text_field: text
    group_field: id
    expected_fields: [text, id]
    filter: none
    targets: {dev: 1_000_000, test: 3_000_000}
configs.elm_javascript.yaml:
base: base_elm.yaml
run_name: elm_javascript
model_init: /workspace/btm/ckpt/seed
train_data: /workspace/btm/data/tok/javascript/train
configs.elm_law.yaml:
base: base_elm.yaml
run_name: elm_law
model_init: /workspace/btm/ckpt/elm_law_init
train_data: /workspace/btm/data/tok/law/train
configs.elm_python.yaml:
base: base_elm.yaml
run_name: elm_python
model_init: /workspace/btm/ckpt/seed
train_data: /workspace/btm/data/tok/python/train
configs.eval.yaml:
data_root: /workspace/btm/data/tok
logprob_root: /workspace/btm/results/logprobs
results_root: /workspace/btm/results
ckpt_root: /workspace/btm/ckpt
log_root: /workspace/btm/logs
window: 1024
prior_windows: 100
batch_size: 32
dtype: fp32
attn_implementation: sdpa
splits: [dev, test]
domains: [python, javascript, law, typescript, rust, contracts, web]
in_domain: [python, javascript, law]
held_out: [typescript, rust, contracts, web]
elms: [elm_python, elm_javascript, elm_law]
topk: [1, 2]
configs.smoke_python.yaml:
base: base_elm.yaml
run_name: smoke_python
model_init: /workspace/btm/ckpt/seed
train_data: /workspace/btm/data_smoke/tok/python/train
global_batch_seqs: 32
train_tokens: 2_621_440
eval_every_steps: 20
resume_ckpt_every_steps: 10
ckpt_root: /workspace/btm/ckpt_smoke
